verdict.rationale: Docs state self-hosted Skyvern runs with 'your own LLM API keys' on your own infrastructure, implying model-agnosticism rather than lock-in to a single vendor, but there is no explicit list of supported providers/models or first-party guide on swapping LLM backends, and no independent confirmation of multi-provider support. Missing for 10: an explicit supported-providers list/config docs, and community/hands-on evidence of using non-default LLMs.
